content.name: Spider's Sting
entries: A creature subjected to Spider's Sting must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 1 hour. If the creature fails the save by 5 or more, the creature also has the {@condition Unconscious|SRD52} condition while {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
